# 00000007198

**English.** Definition: The Chow group is the group of rational-equivalence classes of algebraic cycles. Conjecture: The kernel of rational equivalence is generated by the linear relations of degeneration divisors; and the computation of the kernel reduces to the explicit iteration of the moving lemma of intersections. (moving-lemma kernel of rational equivalence)

**中文。** 定义：Chow 群指代数闭链的有理等价类群。猜想：有理等价的核由退化除子的线性关系生成；且核的计算归约为相交的移动引理的显式迭代。（Chow 有理等价核移动引律）
